verdict.rationale: Appwrite is API-first: its docs, CLI, and SDKs cover projects, databases, files, users, functions, and messaging, and the CLI/MCP server explicitly expose 'creating and managing projects, managing resources (rows, files, users), creating and deploying Appwrite Functions, and other operations available through Appwrite's API,' indicating broad API/CLI parity with the Console. However, the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and there is no explicit statement or independent confirmation that literally 100% of Console-only settings (e.g., billing, org/team management nuances, marketplace one-click installs) are API-reachable. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference confirming full coverage, explicit vendor claim of 1:1 UI/API parity, and independent/hands-on verification that no Console-only actions exist.
